text.p: Banco Santander SA's Mexico unit, Grupo Financiero Santander Mexico, said on Wednesday it had split up into separate banking and investment bank units.
Banco Santander Mexicano will carry out traditional commercial banking, insurance and corporate banking, the company said in a statement.
Santander Investment will handle mutual and pension funds, capital markets, investment banking and corporate finance.
Juan Arenado Arsuaga will head up the Banco Santander Mexicano unit, reporting to the new head of the company's Latin American banking divisions, Ignacio Rasero Gutierrez.
Miguel Alvarez del Rio will be in charge of Santander Investment in Mexico.
